concerns.text: SC‑001 is defined as a pass/fail success criterion (≥ 80 % of 1,000 bootstraps must satisfy d ≥ 0.3 and p < 0.05), but T006 treats it only as a descriptive metric (‘reporting only’) and its verification checks merely that the JSON contains a proportion field, without enforcing the required threshold. This weakens the success criterion and violates the specification.
